summary: Retest of iteration 27 fixes: all pass. Turning prices off in admin hides the 'Estimated total' label and the see-price-button and leaves the save button working, and turning it back on shows the total again ($7,041). On a 390px screen the job sheet title wraps at word boundaries and the client box sits below the title; desktop is unchanged. Print hides the Back/Print buttons while window.print runs. The backend returns 403 'This feature is turned off for this store' for redesign, sketch and try_on when each is off. /redesign shows redesign-unavailable when redesign is off. All 20 '+ Custom' links are 44px tall. All 12 feature toggles were restored to true. No AI calls were made.

issues: The unavailable state is only muted text with no button to open the builder (only the X close). Optional: add an 'Open builder' CTA.
The feature-* Pressables still have no aria-checked/aria-selected state on web (an optional accessibility item from iteration 27).

action_items: Optional: add an 'Open builder' CTA to the redesign-unavailable state.
Optional: expose the toggle state of the feature-* switches to accessibility (aria-checked).
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/sketches checks the customer-access gate (customers.require) before the feature guard. If a store gates sketch behind a level and also switches the feature off, visitors get 'gate:<level>' instead of the feature-off 403. Consider checking the feature first.
seed_data_creation: None. Clicking save-design-button once in the /build test saved a design as an anonymous visitor.
